senses.gloss:
लश् लश्, cl. 10. P. लाशयति, &c., to
exercise an art, do anything scientifically
(= rt. 1. लस्, cl. 10, of which it is sometimes con-
sidered a various reading).

लष् लष्, cl. 1. 4. P. A. लषति, -ते,
लष्यति, -ते, ललाष, लेषे, लषिष्-
यति, -ते, अलाषीत् or अलषीत्, अलषिष्ट, लषि-
तुम्, to wish, desire, long for, be eager for (with
acc.); cl. 10. P. लाषयति, to exercise an art, do
anything scientifically, (in this sense a various reading
for rt. लश् above): Pass. लष्यते, Aor. अलाषि:
Caus. लाषयति, -ते, -यितुम्, Aor. अलीलषत्: Desid.
लिलषिषति: Intens. लालष्यते, लालष्टि, to long
for eagerly; [cf. Gr. λά-ω, (Dor. λῶ, λῇς, λῇ, 3rd
pl. λῶντι), λῆ-μα, λῆ-σι-ς, λι-λα-ί-ο-μαι, λε-λίη-μαι,
λία-ν, λαρός, λωΐων, λήλαντος, probably λα-μία,
λάμος, λάρυγξ, λαιμός, λαίτμα; Lat. las-c-
ivu-s; Goth. lus-tu-s, lus-to-n; Angl. Sax. lust,
lyst, lystan; Slav. las-k-a-ti, ‘to flatter;’ Bohem.
las-ka, ‘love.’]

लस् 1. लस्, cl. 1. P. लसति, ललास (3rd
du. लेसतुः), अलासीत् or अलसीत्, लसितुम्,
to shine, flash, glitter, coruscate, glance; to appear,
come to light, arise; to sound, resound, (connected
with rt. 1: रस्); to embrace; to play, sport, move
about rapidly, dance, jump, skip about [cf. रास];
cl. 10. P. लासयति, &c., to exercise an art, do any-
thing scientifically or skilfully, (in this sense = rts. लश्,
लष्): Pass. लस्यते, Aor. अलासि, &c.: Caus. लास-
यति, -यितुम्, Aor. अलीलसत्, to cause to sport or play,
to cause to dance, teach to dance; to dance: Intens.
लालस्यते, (this form does not seem to occur, but
cf. लालस); [cf. probably Lat. ludo, (according to
some) lascivus, lascivire.]
2. लस्, अस्, अस्, अस्, shining, glittering; [cf. अ-लस्.]

लशुन लशुन, अम्, n., (rarely) अस्, m. garlic,
(sometimes written लसुन.)
लशुनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, garlicky.
लषण, अस्, &c., one who desires or longs for.
लषणा-वती, f., N. of a place.
लषित, अस्, आ, अम्, wished, desired, &c.
लसित, अस्, आ, अम्, played, sported, &c.
लष्व, अस्, m. a dancer, actor.

लषमण लषमण, अस्, m. (= लखमण,
= लक्ष्मण), a proper N.

लषमा-देवी, f. (= लक्ष्मी-देवी), N. of a
princess.

लस, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, glancing, playing, mov-
ing hither and thither [cf. अ-लस]; (आ), f. saffron,
turmeric.

लास, अस्, m. the act of jumping, skipping or
moving about, sporting, dancing, (probably con-
nected with रास); dancing as practised by women;
dalliance, wanton sport; soup, broth, boiled pulse,
pea-water; saliva (? in अ-लास, q. v.).
—लास-वती,
f., N. of a woman.
लास लास, लासिन्, लास्य. See p. 864.
लसक = लासक below.

लासक, अस्, इका, अम्, one who sports or gambols,
playing; moving hither and thither, going through
various evolutions; (अस्), m. a dancer, actor; N. of
Śiva; a peacock; N. of a dancer; embracing, en-
folding, surrounding; (इका), f. a female dancer; a
harlot, wanton; a kind of dramatic performance;
(अकी), f. a female dancer, dancing girl; (अम्), n. =
a turret, tower, room on the top of a building (=
अट्टक).

लसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, shining, glittering, flashing,
glancing; sporting, playing.
—लसद्-अंशु, उस्, उस्, उ,
having flashing or glancing rays (said of the sun).

लसमान, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, glittering; sport-
ing.

लस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, embraced, grasped; skilled,
skilful.
लस्त लस्त, लस्तक, &c. See col. 2.

लस्तक, अस्, m. the middle of a bow (the part
grasped).
लस्तकिन्, ई, m. a bow.

लासयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to dance, causing
to move about.
लासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, moving to and fro, dancing.

लास्य, अम्, n. a dance, dancing; a dance accom-
panied with instrumental music and singing; a dance
in which the emotions of love are mimically repre-
sented, the dance of the Indian dancing girls, a Nach
dance (confined to attitude and gesticulation, with a
shuffling motion of the feet seldom lifted from the
ground; this style is said to have been invented by
Pārvatī and communicated by her to the daughter
of Vāṇāsura, by whom her female friends and com-
panions were instructed in it; it is opposed to the
Tāṇḍava, the more boisterous dance of Śiva and his
followers); a part or particular kind of drama or dra-
matic representation (said to be the occasional intro-
duction of music and singing; also a style of dramatic
composition in which there is abrupt transition from
Prākṛt to Sanskrit and from Sanskrit to Prākṛt,
&c.); (अस्), m. a dancer; (आ), f. a female dancer,
dancing girl.
—लास्याङ्ग (˚य-अङ्˚), अम्, n. that
part of a drama in which the Lāsya described above
is introduced.

लास्यक, अम्, n. = लास्य, a dance, dancing in
general.

लसीका, f. spittle, saliva; the juice of the sugar-
cane; lymph; matter, pus.
लसोफरञ्ज लसोफरञ्ज, N. of a place.
लस्पूजनी लस्पूजनी, f., Ved. a large needle.

लाषुक लाषुक, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (fr. rt. लष्),
covetous, greedy.
लास्फोटनी लास्फोटनी, f. a gimlet, auger.
